name: Cage of Etha
source:
Haunted by his mother’s death, young Emile suffers under his father’s gaze.
Until, one day, he finds solace in another who resembles her.
But is this eerie resemblance a blessing or a mockery of memory?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
母亲的死一直萦绕在年轻的埃米尔心头，他在父亲的注视下备受煎熬。
直到有一天，他从一个与母亲容貌相似的人身上找到了慰藉。
然而，这令人不安的相似究竟是对记忆的慰藉，还是对记忆的嘲弄？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140000/]Steam[/url]]
